title: ELF core dump (ET_CORE)
summary: An ELF core dump uses the same ELF magic (0x7F 'ELF') but with e_type = ET_CORE (4). The program headers are PT_NOTE segments containing process state (registers, memory maps, etc.) in NT_PRSTATUS, NT_PRPSINFO, NT_AUXV, and (for threads) NT_PRSTATUS per thread.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: PT_NOTE segments contain: NT_PRSTATUS (general registers, signal info), NT_PRPSINFO (process info: pid, comm, ...), NT_AUXV (auxiliary vector), NT_FILE (mapped files), and (per thread) NT_PRSTATUS.
Core dumps are generated by the kernel on SIGSEGV/SIGABRT/etc. when ulimit -c allows.
systemd-coredump stores dumps in /var/lib/systemd/coredump/ with metadata.
